<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
rows = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def p0sym():
    r=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('X' if r[rr][cc]=='B' else '.' for cc in range(15,20)) for rr in range(52,57))
def rots(m):
    out=[m]; cur=m
    for _ in range(3):
        cur=tuple(''.join(cur[4-c][r] for c in range(5)) for r in range(5)); out.append(cur)
    return out
def eq(a,b): return any(a==r for r in rots(b))
ptiles={'t12':('XXXX.','X..XX','X...X','XX..X','.XXXX'),'t14':('XXXX.','X..X.','X..XX','X..X.','XXXX.'),'t22':('XXXXX','X..X.','X..X.','XXXX.','X....'),'t24':('..XXX','..X.X','XXXXX','X.X..','XXX..'),'t32':('XXXXX','X...X','X.XXX','X.X.X','XXXXX'),'t34':('..X..','XXXXX','X.X.X','XXXXX','..X..')}
start=p0sym()
seq=[start]
matches=[ [t for t,tm in ptiles.items() if eq(start,tm)] ]
for i in range(16):
    action(['UP'])
    s=p0sym()
    seq.append(s)
    matches.append([t for t,tm in ptiles.items() if eq(s,tm)])
    if s==start:
        print("returned to start after",i+1,"cycles"); break
print("start",start)
for i,(s,m) in enumerate(zip(seq,matches)):
    print(i,s,m)
